grammar_focus: 动名词 -ing 的用法(KS20)主考——动名词作主语(Eating is a pleasure)、介词后用动名词(keen on cycling / without saying / for not letting)、动词后接动名词(start/keep/enjoy/mind + doing)、动名词的否定(not + doing);so…that / such…that、need + doing(表'需要被…',被动含义)、run after / catch up with、out of breath(辅考·课文①类)
scene: 安·斯特林夫人和孩子们正在森林边野餐时,两个男人冲到她跟前,企图抢走她的手提包。争抢中带子扯断了,包落入两人手里,他们拔腿跑进树林。斯特林夫人非常气愤,不顾风险追了上去。她很快就上气不接下气了,但仍继续追赶。当她追上他们时,发现两人已坐下来,正翻看包里的东西,于是她直冲过去。两个男人吓了一大跳,扔下提包就逃跑了。“这提包带子需要修理,”斯特林夫人事后说道,“不过他们什么也没偷走。”

grammar_card.title: 动名词 -ing:动词当名词用
grammar_card.intro: 动词加 -ing 变成动名词,可以像名词一样用:作句子开头(Eating is a pleasure)、放在介词后面(keen on cycling / without saying)、放在某些动词后面(start / keep / enjoy / mind + doing);否定就在前面加 not(not letting)。全用本课和 Key structures 的句子举例。

rows: Eating is always a pleasure.(吃是一种享受)
I am keen on cycling.(热衷骑车)
He sat there without saying anything.(一言不发)
Both men started running.(开始奔跑)
I apologize for not letting you know.(没让你知道)

specialRules.rule: enjoy / keep / mind / finish 等动词后面只能接动名词(-ing),不能接 to do:enjoy running(不是 enjoy to run)。
need + doing 表示'需要被…'(被动含义):The strap needs mending = 背带需要(被)修理。

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — How did Mrs. Sterling get her bag back?
options: She chased the thieves and ran straight at them until they dropped it

passage: Mrs. Anne Sterling did not think of the risk she was taking when she ran through a forest after two men. They had rushed up to her while she was having a picnic at the edge of a forest with her children and tried to steal her handbag. In the struggle, the strap broke and, with the bag in their possession, both men started running through the trees. Mrs. Sterling got so angry that she ran after them. She was soon out of breath, but she continued to run. When she caught up with them, she saw that they had sat down and were going through the contents of the bag, so she ran straight at them. The men got such a fright that they dropped the bag and ran away. 'The strap needs mending,' said Mrs. Sterling later, 'but they did not steal anything.'
